label: A · 横向分类色带 + 三列目录卡 + 右栏
prompt:
Design a full-bleed web page for a Chinese university second-hand marketplace, rendered edge to edge at 1536×1024, no browser window, no address bar, no device frame, no desk. The page is shown as the page itself, not as a screenshot of a browser.

VISITOR'S JOB (readable from the image alone): a student scanning a catalogue of things other students are selling, deciding in seconds whether anything here is worth opening, and clicking one item to message its seller.

STRUCTURE, named in order with scale relationships:
1. Top bar, full width, 64px tall: product name in Chinese「校园二手交易平台」at left in semibold 18px; horizontal navigation in the centre at 14px (首页 / 发布 / 我的商品 / 消息 / 订单 / 个人中心); at right a search input 260px wide and a small unread-count badge.
2. Below it, a full-width classification band 60px tall — the page's dominant colour field. Eight equal segments side by side. Each segment is a very light tint field with a 4px solid saturated bar drawn along its bottom edge, and it holds the Chinese category label in ink with a monospace count under it: 「教材书籍 2」「数码电子 4」「生活用品 3」「运动户外 1」「服饰鞋包 1」「美妆护肤 1」「乐器文具 0」「其他闲置 1」. Flat fills only, no gradient, no rounded corners. The first segment is the active filter: its tint is slightly deeper, its bar is thicker, and its label is semibold.
3. Main area, a three-column grid of catalogue cards (three columns, equal width, 24px gutters) occupying the left nine twelfths of the page width.
4. Right rail, three twelfths wide: a small directory-statistics panel reading「目录里 13 张卡 · 5 类」plus a stacked list of two recommended items with a one-line reason each.

CATALOGUE CARD anatomy, in this exact order: a 4:3 product thumbnail at top (plain flat product photograph on a pale grey seamless ground: a used textbook, a laptop stand, a tablet, a desk lamp, a ceramic mug, an earbud case); a small monospace catalogue code directly under the image, e.g.「TP311.5/12」in 12px letter-spaced uppercase; the product title in 15px, two lines maximum; the price as the largest type in the card — 22px semibold ink, with a small ¥ before it and a small「元」after it; then a 13px metadata line: seller nickname, a credit score, the campus, and the hand-over place; then a status mark at the card's bottom-left rendered as a small flat label (在售 outlined, 交易中 half-filled, 已售出 filled with a strike-through).

SIGNATURE INTERACTION, shown on exactly one card near the top-left: that card is displaced 6px to the right and 6px down out of the grid, its 0.5px rule line is redrawn around the displaced position, and a 13px annotation line is revealed in the space it vacated, reading a one-line reason such as「因为你收藏过《数据结构》」. All other cards sit flush in the grid, quiet.

Real content to place in the cards, verbatim Chinese titles and prices:
九成新《数据结构（C语言版）》教材 — ¥15.00 — stu_test01 — 东校区图书馆门口
iPad Air 5 64G 深空灰（自用一年） — ¥2680.00 — stu_test01 — 东校区一食堂门口
《计算机网络（第7版）》教材 九成新 — ¥18.00 — stu_test01 — 东校区图书馆门口
笔记本散热支架（铝合金 六档可调） — ¥42.00 — admin — 主校区
宿舍小台灯 护眼款 — ¥25.50 — stu_test01 — 3号宿舍楼下
漫步者蓝牙耳机 半入耳式 — ¥65.00 — stu_test01 — 东校区一食堂门口
迪卡侬哑铃一对 5kg — ¥45.00 — stu_test01 — 东校区操场西门
优衣库摇粒绒外套 M码 — ¥55.00 — admin — 主校区体育馆门口
珀莱雅精华水 余量九成 — ¥78.00 — admin — 主校区快递驿站

PALETTE, used exactly, each colour doing a stated job:
ground #F5F6F3 (cool paper white, the page background); card surface #FFFFFF; subtle fill #E9EBE5; hairline rules #C9CCC4 drawn at 0.5px; ink #1A1D19 for all text and solid primary buttons; muted text #5C6159 for metadata. The eight classification colours as solid bars, low-saturation: #7A5A2E, #1F5A6B, #35603F, #6B6A2E, #7A4260, #8C3B5A, #3A4A7A, #5A5F58, each paired with a very light tint of itself (#F1EAE0, #E4EEF0, #E6EFE8, #EFF0DF, #F2E7EC, #F5E6EB, #E7EAF3, #ECEEEA) that fills the field behind it, the solid bar drawn as a 4px edge. Status: 在售 is #1A1D19 outline; 交易中 is #7A5A2E half-fill; 已售出 is #8A8F86 fill with a strike-through.

TYPE: a workhorse Chinese UI sans (PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei character), regular and semibold only; and a monospace face (Consolas character) for the catalogue codes and any digits in tables. No serif anywhere. Type does the hierarchy through weight, size and rule lines, not through colour.

MATERIAL AND MOOD: printed library catalogue card stock and shelf labels — flat ink on paper, hairline rules, monospace shelf codes, flat colour bands. Calm, legible, dense but orderly, like a well-kept card catalogue under reading-room daylight.

EXCLUDE: warm cream or beige backgrounds; any serif lettering; terracotta, brick or signal-red accents; gradients of any kind; glassmorphism; large soft drop shadows; rounded pill buttons; illustrated mascots; texture photographs of paper grain; browser chrome; English interface labels; invented brand logos, ratings, testimonials or statistics; any element that could be mistaken for a real company's branding.

The page must read as a working product screen at real reading size: body text near 14–16px, controls sized for a mouse, and the whole first viewport carrying navigation, the classification field, at least six catalogue cards, the pull-out reveal, and the right rail.
